intro: A public method timeline — what changed in the operating system around the model, not who was in the room.

events.title: Hands-on LLMs on real work
events.body: Moved from curiosity into daily engineering: drafting, scaffolding, and iterating with frontier models on problems that had to ship.

events.title: Public vibe-coding demo
events.body: Shipped a small public visualiser as a concrete proof that agents can build UI fast — useful, imperfect, instructive.

events.title: Cursor as the cockpit
events.body: Standardised on an agentic IDE: read the tree, run commands, leave diffs — end the copy-paste loop.

events.title: Agents meet hardware
events.body: The same cockpit reached real repositories and remote development targets. Humans kept the reins when the model drifted.

events.title: Tool protocols for systems
events.body: Model-facing tool interfaces stopped being a novelty and became how agents inspect and act on engineering systems — carefully, with least privilege.

events.title: Harness becomes durable
events.body: Skills and rules left chat folklore. They became versioned artefacts you can restore, review, and improve on purpose.

events.title: Domain skills compound
events.body: Embedded bring-up, lab workflows, docs, and comms skills accumulated — each encoding a failure we refused to repeat.

events.title: Always-on diet
events.body: Learned the hard way that every always-on rule and integration taxes every turn. Most constraints became requestable.

events.title: Patterns & parallel lanes
events.body: Cross-cutting working patterns gained an explicit sign-off lifecycle. Named lanes made team-shaped solo bursts possible without losing accountability.

events.title: MemPalace as durable memory
events.body: Curated drawers and a light knowledge graph became the memory layer — searchable facts for Kaizen/Hansei, not a dump of every transcript.

events.title: TWP names the learning core
events.body: Toyota Way Practices (TWP) became the umbrella for the lean cluster: Kaizen/Hansei, poka-yoke, muda/jidoka, shoshin, kyosei, respect for people — load the member that matches the pain.

events.title: Fail-closed outbound
events.body: Draft freely; irreversible sends and publishes require a human gate that shows the full referent. Speed is not consent.

events.title: Public lab notebook
events.body: Published this privacy-safe map: clocks, stack, playbook, starters, capability view, and measurement honesty.

events.title: Preloop under P0 gates
events.body: Started layering Preloop as a durable runtime policy/audit plane on tool use — under existing human gates, not instead of them.

events.title: OpenRouter for model routing
events.body: Started using OpenRouter for multi-model access: provider failover and optional model fallbacks, with keys vaulted and proof class unchanged.
